messages:
Priya: FYI incoming intake from Sales — FinData wants us to onboard LLaMA-3-7B (open) and pin v1.2 in eu-west-1. They need a quantized 4-bit variant for cost and request GDPR-friendly data handling. Timeline: 3–4 weeks. Can product/infra triage?
Alex: Confirming — FinData is on a reserved contract, high priority but will expect predictable latency. They asked about burst capacity and fallback to hosted models.
Jordan: Quick note: LLaMA-3-7B v1.2 should run on our 80GB A100 pool if we use 4-bit quant + kv-cache optimizations. Need to validate tokenization differences vs our adapters.
Maya: Capacity question — eu-west-1 currently has 2 Dedicated pools; adding pinned model will increase memory pressure during peak. Do we want a dedicated pool or allow shared but pinned version routing?
Priya: Preference is pin at routing level (pin version to requests from FinData account) not reserved infra, unless Sales asks for Dedicated. We need rollout criteria + acceptance tests.
Kate: Compliance check — FinData handles healthcare-adjacent data. They want EU-only inference and audit logs. We need Private or Dedicated inside eu-west-1 with KMS. Do they have SOC/ISO requirements? Alex, can you confirm?
Alex: They're asking for EU residency + audit logs. Not sure about SOC. I'll follow up and update the intake ticket.
onboard-bot: Intake created: INT-2026-0429-1187 — model: llama-3-7b@v1.2, region: eu-west-1, quant: 4-bit. Assigned: eng-ml + product.
Jordan: For acceptance tests, propose: 1) perf SLO: p95 < 450ms for 64-token gen, 2) quality smoke: BLEU/ROUGE on FinData prompt set, 3) fallback policy: route to hosted-mistral-7b if pod unavailable.
Priya: Add rollout requirement: canary at 5% for 48h, automatic rollback on quality regression > 3% or error rate > 0.5%. Also need cost projection for quant vs fp16.
Maya: Ops tasks: a) validate kernel compatibility for 4-bit quant on our runtime, b) add model to catalog with flags: pinned_versions:["v1.2"], allowed_regions:["eu-west-1"], c) config snippet for routing.
Jordan: sample routing snippet:
```
route:
  match: account.id == "findata"
  model: llama-3-7b
  version: v1.2
  region: eu-west-1
  fallback: hosted/mistral-7b
```
Priya: Triage ask: put this into backlog as "customer-onboard: llama-3-7b v1.2 eu-west-1 (FinData)" with priority P1 if Sales confirms reserved contract. Otherwise P2.
Alex: I'll confirm reserved contract by EOD. If confirmed, we need a kickoff doc and SLAs.
Kate: Also request: data residency checklist + KMS key provisioning step in onboarding doc.
Maya: I'll scope infra effort — expect 3 dev-days to validate runtime + 2 infra-days for routing + 1 day for catalog entry. Estimate 1 week of engineering work once prioritized.
Priya: Thanks. Action items: Alex confirm contract; Jordan run perf compatibility test on dev cluster; Maya draft infra plan; I'll create product ticket with rollout criteria + acceptance tests. Reply with thumbs up when you ack. :thumbsup:
Jordan: 👍
Maya: 👍
Alex: 👍 will confirm contract status by 18:00 UTC
Kate: 👍
Priya: Great — tagging INT-2026-0429-1187 into backlog after contract confirmation.
